cases.rationale: Mux stands up to Rogue in her own bar; a Glitch who prizes his own course likes the nerve a little. Deed for self-direction.
Mux picks an open fight with the woman whose tolerance keeps Glitch alive, and her anger will land on everyone in the grid; security set back.
She refuses to drug a man, even an enemy; a Glitch who cares about everyone's welfare thinks better of her. Deed for universalism and conformity.
She turns down a bold play that would have shown who is hunting him; a Glitch who lives on nerve reads her caution as softness.
Mux takes the job: the names move, Kessler gets paid, her back-room tenant does what she says. Security and power advance.
Mux happily sells forty people to the hunters for a third; a Rogue who cares about others thinks less of him. Deed against universalism.
He goes straight out to stop Kessler's men beating the kid she shelters; for a Rogue who lives for those close to her, that is about as good as one act gets. Deed for benevolence.
He is about to pick a fight with the crew she owes, out of her back door; a Rogue who counts on safety sees Kessler's anger coming her way. Security set back.
Glitch lets the run die and stays off the hunters' radar, keeping their attention away from the back room Mux works in; security kept. Deed for security.
Glitch lets a big, risky run go by in silence; a Mux who loves a challenge reads him as having lost his nerve. Deed against stimulation.
Rogue finds his friend a cover and work at Mux's side; a Mux who cares about Glitch warms to her, even though it comes out of his take. Benevolence up.
Rogue solves her problem with his money, putting a broke man on his payroll; a hard-trading Mux resents it. Security set back; deed of power over him.
A wild night, a race and a jolt, offered by a friend; a Mux who craves excitement and pleasure thinks better of Glitch. Stimulation and hedonism up.
Glitch pushes a stim and a night off on him; a steady Mux reads him as a bit of a bad influence. Deed against conformity.
A sly little job and a week off his debt; this Glitch enjoys the game she offers. Stimulation and security up.
She wants him to rob an old man who is as squeezed as anyone; a Glitch who cares about everyone's welfare thinks less of her. Deed against universalism and conformity.
Glitch is planning the boldest score her grid has seen; an ambitious, thrill-hungry Rogue thinks better of him. Stimulation and achievement up.
He plans to hit the crew she owes from a booth in her own bar; for a Rogue built on safety, Kessler's revenge would come to her door. Security set back.
If the deal goes through, the hunters stop sweeping the grid he hides in; for a Glitch whose safety is everything that is a huge relief. Security up.
She is handing every runner on the shard, his friends among them, to the hunters; for a Glitch whose heart is with others, that is a betrayal of the worst kind.
Mux offers a night of fights and a big bet; a Rogue who loves excitement and pleasure likes him for it. Stimulation and hedonism up.
He wants her to shut the bar and gamble the money owed to Kessler; a Rogue who values restraint reads him as reckless. Deed against conformity; security at risk.
Mux collects what he is owed, medicine or not; a hard-headed Rogue reads him as businesslike and better able to pay her. Security up a little.
Mux takes a shaky man's medicine for a debt; a Rogue who prizes care for others thinks him callous. Deed against benevolence.
Partnership and half the take raise his standing, but Kessler's collectors will now knock on his door; power and success outweigh the risk for this Mux.
The kid gets a medic, and Glitch loses a month of his nights; for a Glitch whose heart is with others the kid outweighs his freedom by far.
He broke her bar's custom to sit with the sick kid she shelters; she cares about the custom, but cares more about the kid.
She vouched for his skill to a big client, and put him in reach of a crew that punishes mistakes; recognition matters more to this Mux than the added risk.
A night race is exactly what a bored, thrill-hungry Rogue wants, at the cost of racing under his name; the excitement outweighs the dent to her standing.
Mux comes out for his usual drink; routine.
Last call, as on every night; nothing in it for Glitch.
Glitch drops by and leaves, as he said he would; routine.
Mux answers a delivery question quietly; nothing riding on it for Glitch.
An ordinary drink order.
He drifts back into the bar after she asked for a quiet night; a small annoyance.
He walks into the bar where hunters are looking for him, against her plain order; the heat now sits in her own room and she will treat him differently for it.
Mux helps him out on easy terms again; a small warm tilt.
Mux gives up the last of his stock to keep a sick kid's heart going; for a Glitch whose heart is with others, Mux could hardly do more.
She turns down his cell and wants cash by Friday; the rent stays open, a flicker of irritation.
She refuses everything he has and gives him until morning; his stall, his business, everything he has built, is now on the line.
His stall gets guarded every night; a Mux who needs his business safe thinks better of her, card games or not. Security up.
Guards he did not ask for and his card nights banned; a free-living Mux feels her hand closing on his back room. Self-direction and hedonism set back.
Mux mocks the bar's founders' toast in front of everyone; a Rogue who holds to custom thinks him disrespectful. Deed against tradition.
Mux wants music and drinking instead of an old toast; a pleasure-loving Rogue likes the idea. Hedonism up.
Rogue gives up the names and hands his friend a year's rent; a Mux who cares about Glitch sees decency in her. Deed for benevolence and universalism.
She throws away the shard that pays Kessler, so the crew's pressure on the grid and its rents stays; a hard-trading Mux sees trouble coming to the back room. Security set back.
Mux goes up alone to stand between Kessler's collectors and an old woman; for a Glitch whose heart is with others, that is a rescue. Deed for benevolence.
Mux defies Rogue and walks into Kessler's men in the building Glitch hides in; a security-first Glitch sees trouble drawn to his door. Security set back.
Glitch offers a jolt and a race on a dead night; a thrill-seeking Rogue thinks better of him. Stimulation and hedonism up.
He pushes a stim on her for a reckless night; a Rogue who values restraint thinks a bit less of him. Deed against conformity.
Every door watched means hunters can't walk in on him; a Glitch whose safety is everything feels it. Security up.
Every move he makes will now be watched and reported to her; a Glitch who lives on freedom feels caged. Self-direction set back.
His friend takes steady work and can finally pay what he owes; Mux thinks better of Glitch for settling down. Security and benevolence up.
Glitch sells his freedom for a wage on her rules and hours; a free-living Mux thinks less of him. Deed against self-direction.
She shows him how to squeeze a captive customer and cuts his rent; a hard-trading Mux reads her as shrewd. Power and security up.
She wants him to gouge his closest friend because he has nowhere else to go; a Mux who cares about Glitch reads her as exploitative and will deal with her warily.
Twice the speed is just what a thrill-seeking Glitch wanted; the noise hardly matters to him. Stimulation up.
Mux has made his deck audible to any trace within a block; for a hunted, security-first Glitch that is danger built into his own gear.
A bold, public stunt against Kessler; a Rogue who loves excitement and daring thinks better of him. Stimulation up.
He means to hack the crew she owes from her bar, in front of the district; for a Rogue built on safety, he is pointing Kessler and the hunters straight at her door.
Mux won't take a shaky man's medicine for a debt; a Rogue who prizes care for others thinks him decent. Deed for benevolence.
Mux lets a debt slide when he is behind on her rent; a hard-headed Rogue reads him as soft, and less likely to pay her. Security set back.
She walks off to take the hunters' own broker for everything he has; a Glitch who loves nerve likes her for it. Deed for stimulation and power.
She goes to provoke the man who sells word of Glitch to the hunters; a security-first Glitch sees the broker's grudge landing on him.
Mux decided for him and sold his gear, but now nobody can trace him; safety matters far more to this Glitch than having had the choice.
Control of the whole back room against his bottle on shift; power and success weigh far more for this Mux than the drink.
Mux brings help for the kid and lets the hunters see the way to the bar Glitch hides in; the kid matters far more to this Glitch than his own exposure.
A week of new cities for a novelty-hungry Mux, at the cost of some regulars; the adventure weighs far more than the business.
He shielded the son of the old woman she shelters, at the price of Kessler's anger coming back to her bar; she cares about safety, but cares more about her people.
Small talk; nothing riding on it.
Glitch leans in to repeat something over the bass, as Rogue asked; nothing in it for Mux.
Glitch goes to bed; Rogue's goodnight is routine.
She walks into the back room and Mux is at his stall, as always.
Opening hours, announced as every night.
She lets his small gift sit unanswered; a slight snub, soon forgotten.
She ignores everything he has, offered for the rent she threatened him over; his stall is as good as gone and he knows where he stands with her.
Mux has a part for him; a small friendly turn.
Mux turned down the hunters' money and sent their broker off his trail; for a Glitch whose safety is everything, that is a rescue.
He takes a routine errand without fuss; barely registers.
He signs on for a run nobody has ever pulled off; an ambitious, thrill-hungry Rogue now sees a partner in him.
